title: Implement log rotation for unified logging
description:
Add log rotation to the logs package to prevent unbounded disk usage. Features needed:
- MaxSize option for log files (default 10MB)
- Rotate logs when size exceeded
- Keep N rotated logs (default 5)
- Compress old logs
- Update logs.EnsureDir to handle rotation setup

Acceptance criteria:
- Log files rotate when MaxSize is reached
- Old logs are compressed with gzip
- Oldest logs are deleted when max count exceeded
- Tests verify rotation behavior
